data.title: 提丰 · 咖啡店给你留了靠窗位
data.description: 街角咖啡店里，提丰穿松绿绞花针织与黑色连裤袜的完整便装，坐在窗边双人桌的一侧。她把对面椅子轻轻拉开，抬头看向刚到的你；桌上两杯热饮还冒着气，围巾收在椅背上。
data.location: 街角咖啡店窗边双人桌
data.action: 坐着拉开对面的空椅子，抬头迎接镜头
data.promptProse: Typhon sits at one side of a cafe table in her forest-green cable-knit casual outfit and black tights. She draws out the opposite chair for the arriving viewer, two steaming drinks between them and her scarf on the chair back. The eye-level cowboy view includes the window beside her. Soft daylight defines knit stitches and cup rims, with gentle tabletop shadows beneath her forearm.
